<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **3** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`  _(via maxVisible (symbol, a field of const object PageHeaderProps, an authorable key of ui/PageHeaderProps), mobileMaxVisible (symbol, a field of const object PageHeaderProps, an authorable key of ui/PageHeaderProps))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via maxVisible (symbol, a field of const object PageHeaderProps, an authorable key of ui/PageHeaderProps), mobileMaxVisible (symbol, a field of const object PageHeaderProps, an authorable key of ui/PageHeaderProps))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via PageHeaderProps (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **174** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cbc50a5a8ecc47eb5c5246fe90ab67d3570e625a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8fde2cc751d57d558b7d65436b9b9b63a0a9060c` — the merge of head `263001fa76362cbf617179f85706cecedb83075b` into base `cbc50a5a8ecc47eb5c5246fe90ab67d3570e625a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8fde2cc751d57d558b7d65436b9b9b63a0a9060c && git checkout 8fde2cc751d57d558b7d65436b9b9b63a0a9060c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin cbc50a5a8ecc47eb5c5246fe90ab67d3570e625a 263001fa76362cbf617179f85706cecedb83075b && git checkout -B drift-repro cbc50a5a8ecc47eb5c5246fe90ab67d3570e625a && git merge --no-ff 263001fa76362cbf617179f85706cecedb83075b

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cbc50a5a8ecc47eb5c5246fe90ab67d3570e625a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs cbc50a5a8ecc47eb5c5246fe90ab67d3570e625a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读
- 只改说明文字，不改任何行为：页面头部「最多显示几个按钮」两个设置项的说明，以前写的默认值（桌面 3、手机 1）和实际不符。
- 现在写清楚：不设置时，记录页的单行头部显示 1 个，其他头部 3 个；手机上记录页底部操作栏显示 2 个，其他头部 1 个。
- 同步改了两处文档里的同一说明。
- 因为改动落在对外发布的规范定义文件里，按规则需要席位做一次接口层面的复核（只核这两句文字）。
- 席位意见：通过；转席位做接口复核，复核通过后分区合并。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · head `263001fa76` · Fixes #35660 (p2, maintainer exception 09:37Z) · K=7 · merge-tree vs `origin/main` clean · governed 0/4 · 4 files, 29 lines · CI 62 success, 11 skipped; the one cancelled `PR-body guards` run (10:00:04Z) is superseded by a success of the same check (10:00:20Z) · 2026-11-20T10:40Z

**reviewFace** (`record-recognisers.mjs`, committed file list + the changeset's `Clause-②: no`): face **`schema`**, tier **`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`**, `hits.schema = [packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts]`, `hits.rules = []`. A published-schema path is an L2 face whatever the edit, so **L2 at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER by the seat is owed**; scope floor = that file. Then the area lands it.

Checked, sentence by sentence against the renderer at this head (`containers.tsx` `PageHeaderActions`, ~2603-2607 and ~3153):
- `maxVisible` unset: desktop takes `defaultMaxVisible ?? 3`, and the record page's one-row header passes `defaultMaxVisible={inBar ? 1 : undefined}` → "1 in a record page's one-row header bar, 3 on any other header" ✔.
- `mobileMaxVisible` unset: the phone bottom bar (`face === 'bar'`) takes `PHONE_ACTION_BAR_BUTTONS` = 2; any other mobile header takes 1 → "2 in a record page's bottom action bar on a phone, 1 on any other header" ✔. The 2 is new against the card's wording and is what the code does.
- No shape change: both keys stay optional with no schema default; only the two `.describe()` strings and the JSDoc above them change. The JSDoc's reason for no schema default (a default would materialize the key on every header) still holds.
- Prose faces checked against the same lines: `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` (the generated reference rows, identical to the new describes) and `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` Default cell (amendment 2, 7036602364). The changeset says the same.
- `action:bar` (`action-bar.tsx` `?? 1` / `?? 3`) is another component with its own keys; untouched and not described here.
- Surface: the 4 files are inside claim 7036160652 + amendment 2.

Required before landing:
- **R1.** L2 by the seat at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on `component.zod.ts` (text only).

## Contract review

**VERDICT: PASS**

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `263001fa76362cbf617179f85706cecedb83075b`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts + none

No file in the diff implements the two strings: the renderer they describe is outside it. Read, not reviewed: `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-bar.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDrawerStack.tsx`. The changeset, the generated `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` and the one cell of `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` are the lane seat's ACCEPT.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set: unchanged, right. Both keys stay `z.number().int().positive().optional()` in the same strict object. The diff moves only the two `.describe()` arguments (855, 858) and two docblock passages (842-844, 849-850).
- Public surface: two description strings of `PageHeaderProps` change in the published schema. No export, key, type or default moves. Right.
- No schema default added: right. A default would put the key on every parsed header, and an authored value outranks the host's `defaultMaxVisible` (containers.tsx:2607), so it would undo the one-button record bar.
- Generated output: `component.mdx:1582-1583` carry the two strings verbatim, and no other tracked file holds either string. Right.
- Gates: 74 check-runs on this head. 62 success, 11 skipped (opt-in or not applicable), 1 cancelled: the first `PR-body guards` run, replaced by a later success of the same name. Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Lint · docs & code guards, Build Docs, the Type Check families, Test Core and Test UI are all green.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/spec` patch: right. The diff publishes description text and nothing else. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: what an author can write, and what a written value means, do not change here. The default itself moved in the renderer under #35593, not in this diff. The `Clause-②: no` line is right, since no export and no accept set moves, and it stands line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset body.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty.
- Deviation (the local test-typecheck needed a larger heap): local tooling only. The Type Check runs on the head are green. Answered.
- Claim surface: held, amendment 2 included. No shape change, no default, no renderer code.
- `out_of_scope_findings` ("carrier: none"): answered in three parts.
  - `ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts:1070-1073` and `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/auto-trigger.ts:24` describe `action:bar`, whose own resolver still falls back to 3 / 1 (action-bar.tsx:232-234). They are correct as written and should not be changed.
  - `containers.tsx:2574-2575` and `1947` / `1949` are stale code comments on `page:header`. They need no carrier of their own.
  - Not in the report: `containers.tsx:3631`, the designer input description of `mobileMaxVisible` ("A positive integer, defaulting to 1"). It is published to `sdui.manifest.json:3547` and the generated `content/docs/ui/components/page.mdx:59`, so it is author-facing, and it now disagrees with the reference row for the phone record bar. It predates this PR and is renderer code outside the claim's surface. Escalated to the seat: one `domain:ui` follow-up card for line 3631 with its regenerated manifest and page, taking the two stale comments along.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. No query, id materialisation or join.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, against the renderer it cites: the one resolver, `PageHeaderActions`, read at this head.

- `maxVisible` (855): holds. The desktop budget is `readMax(maxVisible) ?? defaultMaxVisible ?? 3` (containers.tsx:2607). `page:header` passes a `defaultMaxVisible` of 1 only for the tail it portals into the host's bar (3153, 3492). That draw needs a host bar, a face that is not a phone, a loaded record and record chrome on (3168). The record view gives that bar on every non-phone record, page or pane (RecordDetailView.tsx:5464, recordDrawerStack.tsx:649). The in-page record header (3547) and the non-record header (3570) pass nothing, so 3.
- `mobileMaxVisible` (858): holds. The bar face reads `readMax(mobileMaxVisible) ?? PHONE_ACTION_BAR_BUTTONS`, which is 2 (1929, 2603-2604), and the bar face exists only where the record view gives a phone face (RecordDetailView.tsx:4458, 5822). Every other mobile row reads `?? 1` (2606).
- Docblock (842-844, 849-850): holds. The renderer comment it quotes still reads "overridable on the page:header" (2574), and the reason for having no schema default still stands.
- Tried to break it with: a record page with `recordChrome: false`, a header before its record loads, a record in a drawer on a phone, a narrow viewport that is not a phone, and the print chrome row (RecordDetailView.tsx:5775, which has no `page:header`, so neither key reaches it). Each lands on the "any other header" arm with the number the string gives.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 (nit) — In the phone bar the budget counts every button, the host's Edit included (containers.tsx:2672-2679). On the header row Edit takes no slot. The string gives 2 without saying so, so on an editable record an unset key draws Edit and one of the page's actions. The number is right. Left as an accepted deviation for a later text touch of this row: a fix here would move the head.
